info.title: Locus API
info.description: Property-context APIs for agents. Buyers need no Locus or CDP account API key. Run a free coverage preflight, then pay per call for official-record reports, local-change briefs, policy and ordinance context, and environmental records. Every paid result includes source provenance, caveats, and verify-next steps. Install the Locus agent skill with `npx @velinussage/locus-agent-skill add`.

x-locus-access.note: Paid routes use x402 or advertised MPP payment credentials. Configured x402 routes offer USDC on Base and Solana; the live 402 accepts array is authoritative. OpenAPI payment metadata does not represent a separate API-key requirement.

free.note: The free /tools/call endpoint requires a WRAPPED body: {"name": "<tool>", "arguments": { ... }}. Tool inputs go inside `arguments`, NOT at the top level. Paid /api/<slug> routes are the opposite (flat body).

paid.note: Paid Locus tools take a FLAT JSON body (fields at the top level, e.g. {"address": "..."}). Do NOT wrap the body in {name, arguments} - that wrapper is ONLY for the free POST /tools/call endpoint.

info.x-guidance: TWO CALLING CONVENTIONS (do not mix them): free tools are called at POST /tools/call with a WRAPPED body {"name": "<tool>", "arguments": {...}} (inputs inside `arguments`); paid tools are called at POST /api/<slug> with a FLAT body (inputs at the top level). Sending a flat body to /tools/call, or a wrapped body to a paid route, is the most common 400. Start with the current bundle-first agent choices at https://api.locus.report/.well-known/locus-agent-endpoints.json. The unified free+paid catalog is https://api.locus.report/.well-known/locus-tools.json; the full paid index remains https://api.locus.report/.well-known/ai-tool/index.json. Free catalog scaling knobs: https://api.locus.report/tools/list?compact=1 omits input schemas for small-context discovery, and https://api.locus.report/tools/list?category=environmental filters by category. No buyer account API key is required. Workflow: (1) Call free POST /tools/call with locus_coverage_check (or locus_lane_availability) for the address — the coverage check now SPLITS status by family (civicLaneStatus / parcelStatus / nationalEndpointStatus) and returns an `alwaysAvailable` list of national tools that fire for ANY US address, so a weak civic lane never means 'skip Locus'. New: locus_suggest_workflow (place+intent) returns a ranked endpoint plan. (2) Highest-value paid call: locus-local-policy-brief ($0.07, place+intent) — cited state bills + local ordinances affecting a place, the hardest analysis to self-compile from the free lanes (national LegiScan coverage). Confirm relevant-bill density first for free with locus_local_legislation; the paid brief returns a free diagnostic if nothing relevant is found. (3) Other atomic SKUs: locus-local-trend-brief ($0.05, place+intent) for local-change analysis; locus-place-report ($0.05, address or zip) for the full cited public-record artifact — responses can be large and may expose X-Locus-Report-* headers plus GET /api/reports?settlementTx=. Preserve X-Locus-Report-Id, X-Locus-Report-Url, X-Locus-Report-Artifact-Url, and the settlement proof so the artifact can be retrieved if a client truncates or drops the response body. Supported requests are generated synchronously and can take tens of seconds. (4) Use locus-before-you-sign ($0.07, address+intent) only when one settle is worth the convenience bundle. (5) Use locus-environmental-context ($0.05, address, latitude+longitude, or state+county; heavier call: allow 60-90s) for EPA environmental public-record context and address-level TRI/RCRA proximity, not as a substitute for free locus_environmental_history preflight. Do not use Locus for tenant screening, lending, insurance, employment, appraisal, policing, or safe/unsafe labels.

get.description: Discovery endpoint for Locus free tools. Returns coverage, lane availability, source-card, citation, parcel, policy-source, and environmental read endpoints. Full briefs and full reports remain x402/MPP-paid. Use ?compact=1 for a small name/title/description/category/coverageScope catalog, and ?category=<cat> to filter by compact/full category.

post.description: Call a free Locus tool by name with JSON arguments. Use this for no-charge coverage checks, lane availability, parcel facts, source-card provenance, citation verification, and other bounded local-context reads. This endpoint does not return paid briefs or full paid reports; buy the x402/MPP endpoints only after a free preflight says there is substance here. Paid /api/<slug> routes are the opposite (flat body).

Suppressed police-reported crash counts at 200-1,000m. Coverage: Chicago all-reported; Virginia reportable-threshold; North Carolina partial subsets (K+A and nonmotorist); Pikes Peak region reportable-threshold; nationwide FARS fatal-only companion. Per-source severity and lag; no raw rows or exact points.
Use this when you can call Locus free tools (REST tools/call or MCP).
Use locus-traffic-crash-context instead when your client can only call paid x402 routes; it returns the same records.

name.description: Aggregate traffic-crash context by radius, severity, and mode

address.description: US street address. post.summary: Full cited public-record property report
post.description: Public-record report for a street address or ZIP after free preflight. After settlement or seller-escrow, locus_parcel_financials may show the cited assessor owner-of-record for the same exact parcel, not a contact. Canonical storage remains owner-free; no valuation or screening. npx @velinussage/locus-agent-skill add.
post.x-locus-details: Public-record report for a street address or ZIP after free preflight. After settlement or seller-escrow, locus_parcel_financials may show the cited assessor owner-of-record for the same exact parcel, not a contact. Canonical storage remains owner-free; no valuation or screening. npx @velinussage/locus-agent-skill add. No account API key is required: call the route, read its live payment challenge, then retry with the payment credential. Coverage is checked before charge where applicable; unsupported requests return a free diagnostic instead of a paid artifact. Paid artifacts are generated synchronously, so supported requests can take tens of seconds while Locus fetches and cites public records. The report gathers 27 cited data lanes for the address (locus_place_facts, locus_property_tax_estimate, locus_property_tax_rates, locus_zoning, locus_representatives, locus_wildfire_risk, locus_development_cases, locus_capital_projects, locus_metro_permits, locus_parcel_transfers, locus_transportation_context, locus_transit_context, locus_housing_stock, locus_fair_market_rents, locus_environmental_history, locus_flood_gauges, locus_regulated_facility_compliance, locus_cleanup_sites, locus_storm_events, locus_fema_events, locus_coastal_county_overlays, locus_area_incidents, locus_nearby_places, locus_data_center_watch, locus_coverage_check, locus_parcel_financials, locus_local_legislation) plus nearby proximity records, keeping every lane with real data for the jurisdiction. The artifact carries a deterministic machine index: report.index { schemaVersion: "locus.place-report/1", subject: { queriedAddress, resolvedParcelAddress, parcelId, subjectMatch: exact|approximate|different_parcel|unresolved }, lanes: [{ tool, status: ok|partial|empty|out_of_coverage|source_unavailable, itemCount, primarySources[] }], citations: [{ url, lane }] } and report.access with proof-free URL templates for the /view, /artifact, and /pdf retrieval routes (fill the proof placeholder from your own settlement receipt; artifacts expire 90 days after generation).

expiresAt.description: Expiry of the proof-gated PDF link, shown beside the QR as useful availability metadata.

authority.description: The requester attests this marketing fact. A supplied public-record link remains caller evidence, not independent Locus verification.

observedAt.description: Timestamp when the official record was fetched or the seller assertion was made.

propertyImage.description: Optional licensed subject image. When omitted, Locus generates the hero itself: an upscaled public aerial with the official parcel outline when the address resolves to a discrete parcel, or a tight clean crop otherwise.

role.description: Declares that this is raw subject-property media, never a finished flyer, poster, listing screenshot, or style reference.

url.description: HTTPS URL for the licensed subject-property image. It is composited unchanged after generation and is never sent through the image model.

rightsConfirmed.description: Required caller attestation that Locus may render this image into the paid flyer.

name.description: Listing agent or team name as it should appear on the flyer.

url.description: HTTPS URL for a caller-authorized PNG, JPEG, or WebP logo. The API fetches and embeds it; renderers never fetch this URL.
